# PoppyPages Marketing

> PoppyPages Marketing is a marketing agency in the Triangle area of North Carolina. It builds and runs marketing systems for small businesses in Raleigh, Durham, Cary, Morrisville and beyond: social media content, Google review monitoring and reply drafts, AI search optimization (AEO) and marketing automations. Plans are $485, $1,485 or $2,985 a month, month to month, with no contract.

PoppyPages Marketing is an independent agency and is not affiliated with Poppy AI. Contact: support@poppypages.com. A person reviews all AI-assisted work, and clients approve content before it goes live.

## Services

- [All services and pricing](https://www.poppypages.com/services): the four systems and the three monthly plans
- [Social media management](https://www.poppypages.com/services/social-media-management): done-for-you posts in the client's voice, designed and scheduled
- [SEO and AI search (AEO)](https://www.poppypages.com/services/seo-and-content-strategy): help Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot find and recommend a business
- [Website design](https://www.poppypages.com/services/web-design): fast, clear websites for small businesses
- [Marketing for pediatric practices](https://www.poppypages.com/services/pediatric-marketing): social posts, review monitoring and reply drafts for pediatric and healthcare practices
